shelf.emptyLede: Worldledger keeps your game's world as a sourcebook: chapters for characters, places and factions, entries that link to each other, and every fact one search away.
shelf.step1: Create a world and choose the language its lore is written in.
shelf.step2: Write entries in Markdown. Type [[ to link another entry.
shelf.step3: Follow red links to fill in what your world is missing.
shelf.localNote: No account needed. Everything stays in this browser.

world.title: This volume is still blank
world.lede: Start with one character and one place, then connect them. The rest of the book grows from the links.
world.step1Body: Someone the player will meet early. A few sentences are enough.
world.step2Body: Type [[ inside the text and pick a page, or type a new name. Missing pages show up as dashed red links.
world.step3Body: Click a red link to create that page. Your world fills in where it's thinnest.

intro.title: Your game's world, bound in one book
intro.lede: Worldledger is a lore wiki for game developers. Write characters, places, factions and events as linked entries, see them on a timeline, a map and a graph, and let an AI that has read your world help you keep it consistent.

pages.title: Linked pages
pages.body: Write each entry in Markdown and link it with [[Page name]]. Links to pages you haven't written yet show as dashed red invitations; click one to write it. Rename a page and every link follows.

facts.title: Stat blocks
facts.short: Born, faction, home: facts you can scan
facts.body: Every chapter has its own fields: birth and death for characters, leader and headquarters for factions, your own fields for anything else. Links in a stat block count like any other link.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: Press Ctrl/⌘+K to find any page by title, alias or text. Accents and Turkish dotted and dotless i don't get in the way.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: Give events a date in your world's own calendar and they line up by era. Births, deaths and foundings from stat blocks can join them.

map.title: Maps
map.short: Pin pages to your own map
map.body: Upload your map, zoom in, and pin places to their pages. Pages that don't exist yet show as hollow pins, ready to be written.

graph.title: Relationship graph
graph.body: See every link as a network, coloured and shaped by chapter. Filter it, click a page to see its neighbours, or read the same connections as a list.

ai.title: AI that knows your world
ai.short: Expand, draft, check, with any provider
ai.body: Expand a page, draft a missing one, or check a page and its neighbours for contradictions. Use Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter or a free local model. Only the relevant pages are sent, it writes in your world's language, and nothing is saved until you accept it.

export.title: Backup and export
export.body: Download a full backup, a Markdown folder for Obsidian, or one readable HTML page to share or print. Restore a backup on any device.

local.title: Your data stays here
local.body: Everything is saved in this browser. No server ever sees your lore.

account.title: No account
account.body: Open the page and start writing. Nothing to sign up for.

ai.title: Any AI, or none
ai.body: Bring your own provider and key, run a local model, or skip AI entirely.

engine.title: Any engine, any genre
engine.body: Worldledger doesn't care whether you ship in Unity, Godot, Unreal or your own engine.
